value.stringValue: {"model": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "max_tokens": 2048, "stream": false, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Require users to log in at a web portal backed by our RADIUS server 10.1.0.60 (secret 'r4dsec') before internet access, and apply their per-user policy.\n\nSite notes: the office LAN 192.168.10.0/24 is on fw eth1 (192.168.10.1), the internet on eth2. The RADIUS server already lists fw (10.1.0.1) as a client and returns each user's policy as Filter-Id: `staff` (full internet access) or `web` (HTTP/HTTPS only). The lab's portal daemon /lab/bin/nb-portal (`--listen IP:PORT --radius HOST --secret SECRET`) authenticates a login against RADIUS and adds the client's address to the nft set `inet filter portal_<Filter-Id>`; serve it on 192.168.10.1:8080. The device has no systemd: start daemons directly."}]}
